data.title: Choosing future forms
data.rule_summary: Use will for decisions and predictions, be going to for intentions, and present continuous for fixed arrangements.

explanation.fa: از will برای تصمیم و پیش‌بینی، be going to برای قصد و present continuous برای برنامه قطعی استفاده می‌کنیم.

examples.en: We're meeting the guide at nine.
